{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())
print("Unique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique assay_batch:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("biomarker_baseline -999 count:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())
print("biomarker_final batch B mean:", df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'].mean())
print("biomarker_final batch A mean:", df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'A', 'biomarker_final'].mean())"}
